liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Jerry first used the chord-strumming ending to his opening solo here; it starts around 5:25; Reviewer thinks this was the only song the band pulled off well [15][19]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (2 reviews): Bill Graham recalled dancing to this song in front of the Great Pyramid as a great experience; Reviewer finds this one really good [17][18]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): Reviewer singles this song out as especially good [18]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Guitar work on this song is competent [12]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): A lovely short lead-in precedes it, and the song has inspired moments throughout [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Hamza el Din set**: rare: 5 archived performances [23]
- **Ollin Arrageed**: rare: 14 archived performances [23]
- **Drums**: with friends [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-09-15.mtx.dts.tobin.88924.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 166 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1978-09-15.sbd.miller.87782.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 162 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd78-09-15.sbd.miller.21781.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1978-09-15.nak700.unknown.LMPP.94537.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: On the first disc's opening track, sound is muffled from 9:14 to 11:36, then improves [5]
- **gd78-09-15.aud.dauria.4160.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 15 songs; 137 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [8]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is not top quality but much better than the reviewer expected [13]
- **gd78-09-15.set2-sbd.murphy.5933.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 8 songs; 76 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [9]. Said about its sound: The soundboard tape has small flips and cuts throughout; Vocals are barely audible on Jack Straw and only improve slightly afterward; the mix is poor [11][12]

## Around the show

- Guests: friends [1]
- Reviewer says the band was in high spirits but the playing suffered, perhaps from desert heat, with Jerry erratic [11]
- The audience tape picks up amusing conversation about the eclipse, plus nearby chatter [18]
- Bored audience members can be heard chatting during the jams [19]
- The concert took place during a lunar eclipse [22]
- Reviewer sees it as a failed try at matching the energy of the previous night [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-09-15.mtx.dts.tobin.88924.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by DTS mix by Kevin Tobin; source: See info file [1]. Also: Matrix mix: soundboard and audience sources aligned and synced in Audition 3.0, then encoded to DTS with Surcode [1]
- **gd1978-09-15.sbd.miller.87782.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set One: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) Set Two: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (44.1k) [3]. Also: Front-row Sony ECM280 audience taping, from a cassette master to CD; mastered on 10-inch reels at 15ips half-track [3]
- **gd78-09-15.sbd.miller.21781.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Set one soundboard went multitrack reel to cassette to DAT; set two came from a 10-inch half-track reel; DAT transfers made around 2000 with a Tascam DA20, then CD and EAC to SHN [4]
- **gd1978-09-15.nak700.unknown.LMPP.94537.flac16**: taped by anonymous; transferred by anonymous and SIRMick; source: 2 Nakamichi 700 cardioid mic's, Sony TCM 158 stereo cassette recorder [5]. Also: Most tracks pitch corrected, right channel gain boosted for centering, and crossfades added where the tape was paused [5]
- **gd78-09-15.aud.dauria.4160.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by John D'Auria; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM280 [8]
- **gd78-09-15.set2-sbd.murphy.5933.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Adrian Boot: [1978-09-16 Giza Sound and Light Theater, Cairo, Egypt - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-09-16-giza-sound-and-light-theater-cairo-egypt/) [24]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Gizah Sound and Light Theater - September 16, 1978](https://www.dead.net/show/september-16-1978) [25]
